## Cumulant generating function

Let $Y$ be a random variable. The **cumulant generating function** (CGF) of $Y$ is the log of the moment generating function:

$$C(t) = \log \mathbb{E}[e^{tY}]$$

Show that

$$\frac{d}{dt}C(t) \bigg\lvert_{t=0} = \mathbb{E}[Y] \hspace{1.5cm} \frac{d^2}{dt^2}C(t) \bigg\lvert_{t=0} = Var(Y)$$
